scripts.test:acceptance: npm run build --workspace=@trust/runtime && playwright test --project acceptance
scripts.docs:capture: npm run build --workspace=@trust/runtime && playwright test --project docs-capture
scripts.build:docs: vite build --config vite.docs.config.ts && mv dist-docs/docs-site.html dist-docs/index.html
scripts.zip:docs: npm run build:docs && cd dist-docs && rm -f ../trust-docs.zip && zip -q ../trust-docs.zip index.html && echo trust-docs.zip
